Anant Singh Daughter Wedding Preparations : bihar ke barh men anant sinh ke paitrik ganv nadvan sthit aavas par beti shivangi sinh ki shadi ki taiyariyan jor-shor se chal rahi hain. 25 navanbar ko hone vali shadi ke lie aavas ko sajaya ja raha hai. bhavy samaroh ke lie stup ki aakriti vala aakarshak mandap taiyar kiya jaega. ek taraph anant sinh siyasi vivadon ko lekar charcha men hain, to dusri taraph parivar men shadi ki khushiyon ki taiyari chal rahi hai. dekhie shadi ki taiyariyon ki khas tasviren.
